class.name: ScriptTestAbort
class.brief_description: Cooperative abort primitive for the innermost active [ScriptTestExecution] guard.
class.description: Static helpers that let guarded test code request an immediate abort at the next script checkpoint. Abort unwinds are internal to the guard and are not catchable by test code.

method.name: abort_current
method.description: Flags the innermost active guard on the calling thread for abort with [param message]. Returns [code]false[/code] when no guard is active.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when a [ScriptTestExecution] guard is active on the calling thread.
